questions.architecture: No package, contract, SDK or dependency changes: 16 files, all under scripts/, tests/harness/, .harness/ and docs/. ci-runs.mjs grows one reader method in both sources. No ADR is needed. The landing rule's notion of a 'harness path' is new policy, and it is defined inline in landing-block.mjs with no standard or ADR behind it. That is why it came out broader than the harness (F1).

findings.evidence: landing-block.mjs:5 HARNESS_PATHS = /^(scripts\/|tests\/harness\/|\.harness\/|\.github\/|\.githooks\/|\.agents\/|\.claude\/|docs\/|AGENTS\.md$|CLAUDE\.md$)/. Under scripts/ are product and contract sources: scripts/fonts/build-font-engine.mjs (the shipped font WASM), scripts/format/goldens.mjs and corpus.mjs (format fixtures), scripts/core/pack-schemas.mjs, scripts/dsl/fluxscript-schema.test.ts and examples.config.ts (packages/dsl's test:examples), and scripts/docs/authoring-guide.mjs (the apps/docs build). docs/ includes docs/requirements/ and docs/architecture/. :36 uses the commit's own row only on that path test. A parent row is still exempted by /\bHARNESS\b/ on its Req cell, whatever paths the commit touches: land.test.mjs's M18.123 case lands `M0.15` with src/gate.txt under a HARNESS row.
findings.problem: Two bypasses of the block. (a) Two steps. Commit A, `M18.200: docs(harness): ...`, changes only docs/backlog/current.md and adds `| M18.200 | ... | HARNESS | ... | todo |`. It is accepted as an own row on harness paths. Commit B, `M18.200: feat(...)`, touches packages/. The parent row now says HARNESS, so B is accepted too. land.mjs rebuilds commit by commit on HEAD, so both land in one invocation. Before M18.139, the same two steps needed a bookkeeping commit; now any task commit can open them. M18.135's proposed EARS ('Req cell exactly HARNESS (or whose commit touches only harness paths)') does not close this, because an exact-HARNESS row can itself be added by a harness-path commit. The label is self-issued. (b) One step. A commit that brings its own HARNESS row can change the shipped font engine build, format goldens, DSL tests, requirements or ADRs while the block is on.
findings.suggestion: Make the exemption depend on paths, not labels. While a blocking row is open, a task commit other than the blocking row lands only if every changed path is a harness path, whatever its row's Req cell says. Narrow the harness paths to a positive list of harness code (scripts/gates/, scripts/harness/, scripts/ci/, scripts/tooling/, tests/harness/, .harness/, .github/, .githooks/, .agents/, .claude/, docs/backlog/, docs/milestones/, docs/harness/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md). Write the list once, in landing-block.mjs, and cite it from docs/standards or the M18.123 row. Add land.mjs refusal tests, because land is where streams meet the rule.

findings.evidence: precommit.mjs:149 `runAsync(process.execPath, ['--test-reporter=spec', '--test', ...harnessToRun()])`. lib.mjs:41-45 spawns with `{ cwd: REPO_ROOT, ...opts }` and no env, so every harness test inherits the commit hook's GIT_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE. M18.138 added cleanEnv() to one test, last-ci.test.mjs:126 and :19. A grep of tests/ for git spawns without cleanEnv finds none today (compiler-parity filters GIT_* inline, and pack-goldens.test.mjs:28 spawns vitest and sync-versions without cleaning, but neither runs git), so the sweep's claim holds for now. The bug fired twice: stream 2 on M18.125, then again on M18.139's own commit. progress.md says: 'Committing M18.139 on a base without M18.138 hit the very bug M18.138 fixes (the hook's clone test committed the staged index as `M1.4: fix(ci): v`)'.
findings.problem: M18.138's EARS is universal ('WHEN a harness test spawns git or a git-reading script THE SYSTEM SHALL pass an environment without the hook's GIT_* variables'), but the gate covers one test. Imagined mutant: a future test adds `spawnSync('git', ['commit', ...], { cwd: tmp })`. Every check stays green until that test commits a staged index into the worktree being committed. That corrupts history silently, and it does so in the pre-commit ladder. The fix belongs at the ladder, which is the one place that has the hook env.
findings.suggestion: Have precommit pass test steps (node --test harness, vitest) an env with GIT_* removed except GIT_EXEC_PATH. Compute staged-path inputs before spawning, which harnessToRun already does. Prove it with a harness test that runs a probe test spawning bare `git commit --allow-empty` in a temp dir, under the ladder's test-step env and a decoy GIT_DIR, and asserts that the decoy's HEAD is unchanged.
findings.proposed_row: M18.140 Pre-commit ladder strips hook git variables from its test steps (cp15 F2) | HARNESS | WHEN the pre-commit ladder spawns a test step (harness node --test, vitest) THE SYSTEM SHALL pass it an environment without GIT_* variables other than GIT_EXEC_PATH, so no test can reach the repository being committed whatever it spawns; a harness test SHALL run a probe test that spawns bare `git commit --allow-empty` in a temporary directory with the ladder's test-step environment over a decoy GIT_DIR/GIT_INDEX_FILE and prove the decoy's HEAD unchanged | M18.138 | todo
